description: This PHP source file defines the WeeklyTimesheetPeriod class, which extends TimesheetPeriod. It provides methods to calculate the dates within a weekly timesheet period, set the period and start date, and determine the local timezone based on a client offset. The class is part of the OrangeHRM TimeSheetPeriod plugin.

classes.name: WeeklyTimesheetPeriod
classes.description: Represents a weekly timesheet period with functionalities to calculate dates, set period info, and determine timezone based on client offset.

methods.name: calculateDaysInTheTimesheetPeriod
methods.description: Calculates and returns an array of date strings for each day in the weekly timesheet period based on current date and XML start date.

methods.name: setTimesheetPeriodAndStartDate
methods.description: Returns an XML string defining the weekly timesheet period and start date.

methods.name: getLocalTimezone
methods.description: Returns the timezone name corresponding to the client timezone offset.
